verification_gap_result: No verification gaps found by reviewer; parent matrix audit added two further test gaps.

findings.evidence: HTML/file-only drop returns before preventDefault; browser fallback can navigate. Prevent every canvas drop default, insert only plain text, regression added by original implementer.
PUNCTUATION_RUN contains closing » and suppresses required spacing in «mot»:. Remove that exclusion for subsequent French punctuation and test it.

validBoundary does allocate a UTF-8 buffer per coalesced probe. Input is bounded at 128 KiB; no user latency regression was demonstrated. Snapshot caching adds lifecycle state for a negligible bounded allocation and is not introduced in this change.
The external drop path awaits onDrop but never focus(), unlike internal completion. Restore the existing hidden input focus after successful external insertion and test callback invocation.
Espace is feminine in French typography; « Espaces françaises automatiques » agrees with the noun and accurately labels the option. The alleged grammatical defect is absent.

The actual app initialization reads localStorage but browser assertions only covered writing it. Seed a saved disabled setting before initialization, then initialize a fresh module without a saved setting and verify enabled default.

No multiple-ASCII-space case was present. Preserve earlier spaces, replace only the adjacent one, and leave paragraph/tab-leading whitespace runs unchanged; regression documents this existing narrow substitution contract.
Controller Ctrl-copy already starts from reversed 5/1 selection, but direct model copy Undo/Redo only covered forward 1/4. Add reversed model copy restoration coverage.

The drag spec maps its own ProbePoint/DropText commands. The separate spacing spec and docs/us-228-french-spacing.md already map ReplaceRange=17. No protocol consumer loses that command; spec-only expansion is also excluded by review routing.

The « cop ié » typo is confined to the build spec acceptance text, not product/docs. The workflow explicitly rejects findings whose fix edits the build spec; runtime behavior and verification are unaffected.

ReplaceRange intentionally accepts UTF-8 character boundaries for an explicit range edit. Its helper replaces just-inserted punctuation/adjacent space and preserves every other scalar. Valid Unicode grapheme editing is not displayed-text corruption; no reachable user text-loss case was demonstrated. DropText separately enforces grapheme boundaries.

Shift+click must retain existing selection extension; Alt/Meta gestures must reach the existing selector. The guard prevents interception and the targeted regression verifies propagation. User intent does not require Shift/Alt copy-drag; Ctrl alone performs copy. The nonfrozen handoff wording was imprecise, and implementation notes record modifier priority.
The frozen marker matrix promised multipage/zoom/scroll/auto-scroll behavior but the new module tests initially used only one page at zoom=1. Add exact mapping and bounded RAF lifecycle tests.

The added new-opcode ABI section asserted encoding but did not invoke the new commands directly. Browser exercises valid real WASM paths, and Rust tests reject malformed payloads; add direct actual-WASM malformed/new-command tests to support the stronger ABI claim.
Clippy rejects the deliberately reversed literal range. Represent the invalid input as an explicit Range struct, preserving rejection coverage without a lint suppression.
Clippy rejects is_none/expect comparisons. Use guarded matches and a short mutable stats scope, retaining exact results and avoiding deep copies. Targeted release regressions and -D warnings pass.
